exploration.calibration: the shape band, the kernel tolerance, the duration and the conservation thresholds were fixed on the two inspected control scenarios only
exploration.designInformation: the six eligible scenarios were selected from the potential alone: the true-vacuum certificate and the necessary existence condition min(U_eff)<0; no eligible profile or evolution was computed before this file was frozen

inputMapping.source: the frozen Phase-C quartic three-envelope model and the admitted Phase-B resonant-triad candidate
retained: cubic resonant coupling and positive quartic completion
source, Phase-B and Phase-C evidence lineage
restored: the signed-frequency balance omega_1+omega_2+omega_3=0 of Phase B, carried as rotating envelope phases

hypotheses.primaryAlternative: at least one eligible scenario passes vacuum admissibility, frequency balance, evanescence, stationarity, nontriviality, intrinsic localization, the charge-constrained count, unperturbed persistence and the complete declared dynamic bank
hypotheses.primaryNull: no eligible scenario passes every declared necessary gate
hypotheses.secondary: on every scenario with complete numerics the charge-constrained count and the dynamic bank give the same verdict
hypotheses.controls: the inspected stable-branch control passes every gate except eligibility and the inspected unstable-branch control is rejected by both the count and the dynamic bank; otherwise the study is indeterminate
hypotheses.outcomePolicy: report positive, negative, mixed, or numerically indeterminate without adding scenarios after inspection

preregistration.stoppingRule: evaluate exactly the eight scenarios and six perturbations below once; do not expand the grid, change a threshold, or remove a scenario or direction after inspecting results

scope.fieldRepresentation: three complex fields psi_i(x,t)=f_i(x)*exp(i*omega_i*t) with real stationary envelopes f_i and omega_1+omega_2+omega_3=0
scope.domain: one-dimensional finite interval [-L,L] with homogeneous Dirichlet boundaries
scope.conservedCharges: Q_1=N_1-N_3 and Q_2=N_2-N_3 with N_i=integral(Im(conj(psi_i)*dt(psi_i)))dx; on a stationary state N_i=omega_i*integral(f_i^2)dx
scope.vacuumAdmissibility: 27*min_i(m2_i)*g-8*lambda^2>=0 implies U>=0 for every field value, so psi=0 is the global minimum; it is also necessary when the three mass-squared values are equal
scope.gamma: integral((f_1+f_2+f_3)^2)dx evaluated on the stationary envelopes in the co-rotating phase-aligned frame
scope.staticStabilityPolicy: charge-constrained count on the fine grid: n(H)=number of eigenvalues below minus the kernel tolerance of the real-amplitude and imaginary-phase block Hessians of E-Omega_1*Q_1-Omega_2*Q_2; p(d'')=number of positive eigenvalues of minus the symmetrized charge response dQ_a/dOmega_b; the count passes when the near-zero eigenvalues are exactly the three symmetry directions and n(H)=p(d'')
scope.dynamicStabilityPolicy: complex velocity-Verlet evolution of the unperturbed state and of every preregistered perturbation at base, time-refined and space-refined resolution; a run departs when the density peak or the 90-percent support radius about the density centroid leaves the declared factor band relative to the unperturbed stationary state
scope.perturbationFrame: perturbations are added to the envelope with zero velocity in the co-rotating frame, so the laboratory velocity of component i is i*omega_i*psi_i
excluded: unbounded time evolution and instabilities slower than the declared duration resolves
